name: duckdb-results
description: Renders DuckDB CLI agent-mode results as aligned tables under the tool call and in a /duckdb pane, and runs SQL from /duckdb <sql>.

database.description: Database file that /duckdb <sql> opens. Empty runs in memory.
database.title: Database file

autoOpenPane.description: Also open the DuckDB pane whenever a duckdb command produces a result. Off, the table appears only under the tool call, and /duckdb opens the pane.
autoOpenPane.title: Open the pane on results
